title: The Lie algebra structure of $\mathrm{HH}^1(B)$ for blocks with a normal defect group
summary: It is an open question whether the Lie algebra $\mathrm{HH}^1(B)$ of a block of a finite group algebra $kG$ over an algebraically closed field $k$ of prime characteristic $p$ is simple only if the block is nilpotent with an elementary abelian defect group of order at least $3$. We show this to be the case if $B$ has a normal abelian defect group. Another open question is whether $\mathrm{HH}^1(kS_n)$ is a solvable Lie algebra, where $S_n$ denotes a symmetric group on $n$ letters.
